Scheme Name: Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities

Short Title: AAPD


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities" is implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, loans up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to individuals identified as persons with disabilities for agricultural production, irrigation, horticulture, sericulture, the purchase of agricultural machinery and equipment for agricultural services, and the marketing of agricultural products etc. Permanent residents of Haryana, aged 18 years or older, with a disability of 40% or more, are eligible under this scheme.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%.
   1. The applicant should be above 18 years old. For persons with mental retardation, the age requirement is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.


Benefits:
Under this scheme, loans up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to persons with disabilities for agricultural production, irrigation, horticulture, sericulture, purchasing agricultural machinery/equipment for agricultural services, marketing agricultural products, etc.

> **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:**

**Step 01:** The eligible applicant may apply online through the Official Portal- [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/). 
**Step 02**: If the applicant is not registered on the portal, he/she gets registered there. 
**Step 03:** For registration, click “[New User](https://saralharyana.gov.in/citizenRegistration.html)” under ‘Sign In Here’ and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password &amp; State. Click on ‘Submit’.
**Step 04:** Verify your mobile number and email ID through the received OTP and complete the registration process.
> **Login to apply for the scheme:**

**Step 01:** To avail the benefits of the scheme, visit the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) and log in through the email ID used while registering.
**Step 02:** Enter Password &amp; Captcha and click on ‘Login’.

**Step 06:** Preview the application form and click on ‘Submit’.

Applicants can track their applications through the Official [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/) by entering their Department Name, Scheme Name, and Application Reference ID.

Scheme Name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana

Short Title: BVBY


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana”, implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.
Objectives:
To reduce the financial risk for farmers during periods of low market prices for vegetables and fruits by ensuring a protected price.
To encourage diversification in agriculture by supporting horticultural farmers.
Crops covered under the scheme:
21 Crops: Ladyfinger, Chilli, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Cabbage, Radish, Tomato, Onion, Potato, Cauliflower, Carrot, Peas, Capsicum, Brinjal, Turmeric, Garlic, Mango, Kinnow, Guava, Litchi, Plum


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a landowner, lessee, or tenant farmer in Haryana.
   1. The farmer should cultivate one of the 21 listed crops.

**Note 1:** Registration on the [Meri Fasal, Mera Byora portal](https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period is mandatory.
**Note 2:** The land and crop details must be certified by the Horticulture Department.


Benefits:
To make vegetable growers risk free.
To fix protected price for the crops (Ladyfinger, Chilli, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Cabbage, Radish, Tomato, Onion, Potato, Cauliflower, Carrot, Peas, Capsicum, Brinjal, Turmeric, Garlic, Mango, Kinnow, Guava, Litchi, Plum)
In case of selling of fruits/vegetables at lower prices in the market within the prescribed period, the difference in price upto the protected price will be compensated by the Government to the registered farmers.
Note: The incentive amount will be released into the Aadhar linked bank account of the farmer.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana Short Title: PMMSYMSOFRU Detailed Description: The “Subsidy for Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water)” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme aims to promote ornamental fish farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as sheds, breeding units, and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish. The assistance will be provided to beneficiaries who own a minimum of 150 square meters of vacant land with an adequate fresh water facility. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should have at least 150 square meters of vacant land with adequate water supply. 1. The applicant should either own the land or possess a registered lease deed valid for at least 7 years.
Benefits: Tangible Benefits: Project Cost: ₹8,00,000/- per unit Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category applicant. Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC)/Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana

Short Title: FFPPC


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day. The objective is to enhance the availability of high-quality and affordable feed for fish farmers, supporting the expansion of aquaculture in Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, under which the project is jointly funded by the Central and State Governments: 50% of the subsidy amount is contributed by the Central Government, and 50% is provided by the State Government. Beneficiaries are expected to operate and maintain the plant independently and ensure the supply of feed to fishers at affordable prices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease of at least 10 years.
1. The applicant must be willing to operate, maintain, and manage the feed plant after its construction.
1. The applicant must ensure that the feed plant provides an affordable feed supply to fishers and fish farmers.
1. The applicant must submit a valid Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines.
1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate relevant to feed mill operation and maintenance.
1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from legal disputes and must provide a valid land title.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹650,00,000/-
Subsidy Distribution :
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Short Title: ENFFHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The freshwater finfish hatchery should have a minimum capacity of 15 million fry per year per unit or 6.00 crore spawn per year per unit.
1. The hatchery should have a minimum area of 0.50 hectares.
1. The fish hatchery should be managed by qualified technical staff.
1. The applicant will ensure the supply of seed produced from the centrally assisted hatcheries to farmers at an affordable and reasonable price.
1. The fish hatchery will include a brooder pond, nursery ponds, rearing tanks, a small laboratory, water and electric supply, and required infrastructure facilities.
1. The cost of accreditation of the hatchery must be mandatorily included in the project estimates.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme.
1. The lease period or agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicant, having their own land, must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.


Benefits:
The project cost for one unit is ₹25,00,000/-.
The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category.
The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category or women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana

Short Title: LFVCS


Detailed Description:
The "Live Fish Vending Center" Scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). It aims to promote hygienic fish vending and improve fish transportation and marketing infrastructure. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided for setting up a live fish vending center, which may be a fixed center, mobile unit, or a combination of both.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a fisherman.
1. The applicant must have a valid Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra).
1. The applicant should be engaged in fishery-related activities.
1. The applicant must ensure proper operation and maintenance of the vending center.
1. The applicant will receive assistance for only one live fish vending center.
1. The government will not be responsible for any operational loss or damage.


Benefits:
Monetary Benefit:
Financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for setting up a live fish vending center.
Subsidy of 40% of unit cost for general category beneficiaries.
Subsidy of 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters Short Title: SWSCFFSSAANW Detailed Description: The “Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters” is a scheme component under the Scheme for the Welfare of Scheduled Caste Families in the Fisheries Sector, launched by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their socio-economic status by promoting fish farming through subsidization of fishing contract costs in designated water bodies. Under this scheme, a subsidy of up to 50% of the actual auctioned amount of notified water bodies is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries to help them acquire fishing rights in such notified waters. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.
Benefits: 50% subsidy of the actual auctioned amount with maximum limit of ₹5,00,000/- per auction, whichever is less.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development

Short Title: SCDICMD


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana with the objective of encouraging the farmers for conservation and development of the Indigenous breeds of cows and buffaloes. 
Long-term objectives: 
Conservation and up-gradation of valuable indigenous germplasm available in the State of Haryana.
Increase in milk production and overall productivity.
Medium-term objectives (5 years Horizon):
Identification of top-quality germplasm of indigenous breeds of Cow and buffalo and their insemination with high-quality semen for sustainable genetic improvement.
Encouraging the farmers to rear and breed high-yielding animals of genetic merit.
Description of Scheme:
Murrah buffaloes meeting the benchmark of 18 kg daily peak yield would be properly identified (with ear tags) along with their progeny. Cash incentives ranging from ₹15,000/- to ₹30,000/- would be provided to owners of these buffaloes.
Haryana, Sahiwal and Belahi cows, meeting the benchmark of 8 kg, 10 kg, and 5 Kg peak yield respectively would be properly identified (with ear tags) along with their progeny. The cash incentives ranging from ₹5,000/- to ₹20,000/- would be provided to owners of these cows.
The beneficiaries will be under obligation not to sell the buffalo/cow and its progeny for at least one year as the main objective of scheme is to conserve the indigenous breeds of Cow and buffalo.
The identified animals would be insured and part of insurance premium will be borne under the prevailing insurance scheme if any, and rest will be paid by the beneficiary as per insurance scheme.
If no Livestock Insurance Scheme is in operation then the beneficiary would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals on its own and the insurance premium shall be paid by the beneficiary.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant must be of the age of 18 - 55 years.
   1. A Cow or Buffalo eligible to be recorded must be between 05 to 75 days of the date of its Calving as on date of application.
   1. A maximum of two milch animals (two Cows or Two Buffaloes or One Cow and One Buffalo) per applicant/beneficiary would be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme.
   1. The cows must be true to Hariana, Sahiwal, or Belahi breed and buffalo must be of Murrah Breed only.
   1. Incentive for a particular animal could be provided only twice in its life span i.e. if the incentive is provided to a beneficiary for a particular animal twice, such beneficiary would stand debarred for receiving an incentive for that animal in its subsequent calving in the future.
   1. The scheme is individual beneficiary-oriented.

**Note 01:** A maximum of two milch animals per applicant will be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme. However, the recordings of more than two buffaloes/Cows of an applicant may be carried out for collecting data of the top quality Murrah buffaloes/Indigenous cattle (Hariana, Sahiwal, and Belahi). But incentive money would be provided only for two animals (in the highest slabs) of that applicant in a particular year.
**Note 02:** In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept, than the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept (Within state of Haryana only).


Benefits:
1. Cash incentives at the following rates in different slabs would be provided to the owners of the recorded Murrah Buffaloes as below:

In lieu of the cash incentive provided, the owner would be under obligation not to sell the recorded Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and its male progeny at least for one year. The beneficiary would be further bound to look after the male calf properly and the Department will have the first right to purchase it. In case, the beneficiary does not abide by the contract i.e. disposes of the identified Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and/or its male calf, he would not be eligible for the cash incentive. The owners of the recorded cows/buffaloes would be required to breed their animals through artificial insemination by the Government.

raw_text:
Scheme Name: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units

Short Title: SEHTMDU


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities. The unemployed persons will be assisted by way of providing financial assistance in the form of subsidies for establishing dairy units of 4, 10, 20, and 50 milch animals like buffaloes, indigenous cows (Hariana, Sahiwal, Belahi, Red Sindhi, Tharparkar, and Gir breeds only) and crossbred cows.
Medium-term objectives:
To provide gainful self-employment to the unemployed persons.
To supplement the income of the families of the beneficiaries.
To raise the socio-economic status of the weaker sections/Antyodaya families of the society.
To commercialize dairy units by encouraging small dairy unit owners to increase the size of their unit to 20 and 50 milch animals.
Long-term objectives:
Creation of employment opportunities through Animal Husbandry activities.
To increase milk production and Dairy products.
To upgrade and develop valuable Breeds/Germplasm available in the State.
To increase per Capita milk availability in the state.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant must be unemployed (employment even in the private sector will bar an applicant from availing assistance under the Scheme).
   1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. The applicant should have space/shed for keeping milch animals.
   1. The applicant will have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.
   1. The applicant applying for 20 and 50 animal dairy units must have 2-acre and 5-acre agricultural land for green fodder production respectively by way of ownership or long lease.
   1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of livestock units will not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.

**Note 1:** Any applicant who has earlier availed the benefit of the Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a dairy unit below 20 milch animals that applicant will also be eligible for availing of benefit under the Scheme of Dairy unit of 20 and 50 mulch animals only.
**Note 2:** In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept, than the jurisdiction area Government Veterinary Hospital will be the place where animals are kept or intended to be kept (Within state of Haryana only).
>  **Margin Money for 4 and 10 Milch Animal dairy Units only (25 % Subsidy):**

The beneficiary will have to arrange margin money, as per bank requirements, rest of the amount will have to be arranged as a loan from banks.
> **Margin Money for 20 and 50 Milch Animal dairy Units only (Interest Subvention):**

The beneficiary will have to arrange margin money, which will be 25% of the Unit Cost ( Livestock Cost only) and the rest of the amount will have to be arranged as a loan from banks.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance for Interest Subvention under the Scheme:
Dairy units of 4 and 10 milch animals:
25% subsidy on the cost of milch animals can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 4 and 10 milch animals;
The subsidy will be provided three months after the purchase/tagging of Milch animals or disbursement of Loan by the bank, whichever is later, and subject to verification of unit by the concerned veterinary surgeon.
Dairy units of 20 and 50 milch animals:
Interest subvention on 75% cost of milch animals (25% being the margin money) can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 20 and 50 milch animals;
The financial assistance will be provided in the form of interest subvention on loan amount financed by the bank (For Livestock Component only).
The maximum amount for which interest subvention will be provided is as follows:-
Sl. No.
Type of Dairy Unit
Maximum Cost of Unit (Livestock component only) (in ₹)
Max Limit of Loan amount as 75% of Total (for Interest Subvention) (in ₹)

Note:
 The Interest Subvention will be provided for the purchase of livestock components only and on the basis of the Maximum limit of the loan amount as shown in the above table or the loan amount financed by the Bank, whichever is lower.
Financial Assistance for Insurance of Livestock Unit:
If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of unit is to be covered under that Scheme, wherever permissible.
However, if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own.
The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways:
Sponsoring of loan applications to banks / financial institutions.
Purchase of animals, tagging, and issuance of Health certificates.
Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc.
Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division I District Level in the State to the desirous persons.

raw_text:
Scheme Name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units

Short Title: SPEOSCELU


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities to Schedule castes, the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Dairy units, Piggery units, and Sheep/Goat units.
Long-term objectives:
To create self-employment opportunities for the Scheduled Castes families through animal husbandry activities.
To increase milk, wool, and meat production and overall productivity of livestock.
To up-gradate and develop valuable breeds/germplasm available in the State.
To increase per Capita milk availability in the state.
Medium-term objectives:
To provide gainful self-employment to the unemployed men/women of Scheduled Castes families.
To raise socio-economic status and to provide socio-economic security to Scheduled Castes Antyodaya families of Haryana.
To supplement the income of the families of the weaker sections.
The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways:
Sponsoring of loan applications to banks/financial institutions.
Purchase of animals, tagging, and issuance of Health certificates.
Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc.
Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division/District Level in the State to the desirous persons.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
   1. The applicant must be unemployed (employment even in the private sector would bar an applicant from availing assistance under the Scheme).
   1. There will be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
   1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit would not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.
   1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

**General Note:**

  - In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept. Then, the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept or intended to be kept (Within state of Haryana only).
  - Cost of mulch animals has been fixed as per the recommendation of the Unit Cost Committee of National Bank of Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) for the year 2019-20.
  - The cost of the animal as determined by the Veterinary Surgeon may be lower depending upon age, number of lactations, breed characteristics, weight, etc., and the assistance as a subsidy would be provided on this lower cost. However, the maximum permissible cost for a grant of assistance as a subsidy would not exceed the cost indicated against in the tables mentioned above.
  - The cost of Indigenous breeds of Red Sindhi, Tharparkar and Gir cows will be same as Sahiwal cow.
  - Only those breeding animals should be purchased which are ready to bred or in prime age of production.
  - Sexual maturity age in Female Goat &amp; Sheep is 8-12 months. While in the case of Male Goat &amp; Sheep, it is 11-12 months. So, female and male goat and Sheep should be purchased between 12-18 months of age.
  - Sexual maturity age in Sow is 8-9 months. While in the case of Boar, it is 9-10 months. So, the Boar and Sows should be purchased between 8-11 months of age.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance under the Scheme:
Establishment of Dairy units of 2/3 milch animals: 
50% subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2/3 milch animals;
Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:
50% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for the establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
A maximum amount of ₹50,000/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:
90% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
A maximum amount of ₹88,200/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Note 01:
 The subsidy will be provided three months after the purchase of livestock or disbursement of the Loan by the bank, whichever is later, and subject to verification of unit by the concerned veterinary surgeon.
Note 02:
 The unit should be financed through a loan from the bank/financial institution.
Note 03:
 The subsidy would be provided in the loan account of the beneficiary.
Financial Assistance for Insurance of Livestock Unit:
If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of unit is to be covered under that Scheme, wherever permissible.
However, if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own.

Short Title: SPEOSELUMMAPUY


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes by Establishing Livestock Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana. Under the scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana belonging to the Scheduled Caste category can avail a subsidy for purchasing livestock. This subsidy will be provided after the establishment of the livestock units and can be availed as a loan by the beneficiary. The scheme covers the establishment of dairy units with 2 milch animals, 10+1 piggery units, and 15+1 sheep/goat units.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
   1. The applicant must be unemployed.
   1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
   1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance under the Scheme:
Establishment of Dairy units of 2 milch animals:
50% subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2 milch animals;
Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:
50% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
A maximum amount of ₹50,000/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:
90% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
A maximum amount of ₹88,200/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme:
Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year, otherwise the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units

Short Title: SEBPU


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana with an objective to improve the socio-economic and nutritional status of the poor families, small farmers and landless agricultural labourers, and other economically weaker section of the society.
      Backyard poultry is a handy small enterprise with negligible initial investment, however good economic return along with a provision for improving the nutritional status of the members of the beneficiary family through consumption of food items having high protein content like eggs and meat.
Objectives & impact expected:
The long-term objective of this Scheme is to provide nutritional security to poor families, which will also play an important role in their social upliftment.
To supplement the income of the families of the resource-poor beneficiaries.
To improve the nutrition status of beneficiaries and their family members.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit will not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.


Benefits:
50 chicks, 10 day old reared at Government Hatchery along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.

The scheme “Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry &amp; Dairying, Government of Haryana with an objective to improve the socio-economic and nutritional status of the poor families, small farmers and landless agricultural labourers, and other economically weaker section of the society.
      Backyard poultry is a handy small enterprise with negligible initial investment, however good economic return along with a provision for improving the nutritional status of the members of the beneficiary family through consumption of food items having high protein content like eggs and meat.
**Objectives &amp; impact expected:**

  - The long-term objective of this Scheme is to provide nutritional security to poor families, which will also play an important role in their social upliftment.
  - To supplement the income of the families of the resource-poor beneficiaries.
  - To improve the nutrition status of beneficiaries and their family members.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets - Haryana

Short Title: PMMSYCRMHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to support the construction of fish retail markets, including those for ornamental fish and aquariums. Through this scheme, financial assistance for project costs is provided to individual beneficiaries.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) stating that all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them.
1. The applicant must commit to keeping the fish market in operational condition for 10 years.
1. The applicant must agree to permanently display a board at the infrastructure facility indicating that the fish market was constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).
1. Central assistance will be restricted to one unit per individual beneficiary.
1. Projects with land on a long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance. The registered lease period or agreement must not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.


Benefits:
The scheme provides a subsidy for the construction of fish retail markets, including ornamental fish or aquarium markets. The project cost is ₹1,00,00,000/- per unit.
The subsidy provided is:
40% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category.
60% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women categories.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana Short Title: CWIBHR Detailed Description: The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Cycle with Ice Boxes" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide central assistance for the cost of cycles with ice boxes to beneficiaries involved in fisheries activities. Through this scheme, central assistance for Cycle with Ice Box costs is provided for the initial crop only in the purchase of newly purchased cycles with ice boxes. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. Beneficiaries should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. Beneficiaries shall be provided central assistance for Cycle with Ice box the initial crop only in the purchase of newly purchased Cycle with Ice Box 1. Central assistance for Cycle with Ice Box cost shall be released only for the fisheries activity. 1. Govt. of India and Govt. of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurement, operation, maintenance and management of the fish transport facilities.
Benefits: The scheme provides a subsidy for the cycle with ice boxes for fisheries activities. The project cost is ₹0.10/- lakh per unit. The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries falling under the General Category. The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries who are Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women. Note: The Government of India and the Government of Haryana shall not be responsible for any losses incurred on procurement, operation, maintenance, and management of the fish transport facilities.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Construction of New Rearing ponds - Haryana

Short Title: CNRPHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Rearing Ponds (nursery/seed rearing ponds)" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to expand fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds. Through this scheme, central assistance and subsidy are provided for the construction of new rearing units and initial crop costs in newly constructed ponds.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new rearing ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas, only under the construction of new ponds under the PMMSY scheme.
1. The applicant shall be provided with central assistance for the Construction of New Rearing unit costs for the initial crop only in the newly constructed ponds.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.
1. The applicant, having their land, must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.


Benefits:
Provides financial assistance for the construction of New Rearing Ponds (nursery/seed rearing ponds). 
The project cost of ₹ 7,00,000/- per Hectare is provided.
The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana Short Title: PMMSYTWIBIFV Detailed Description: The “Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. Scheme Name: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana

Short Title: PPLCNPSAAHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline Area" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for the construction of new ponds in saline or alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided for new water bodies created under various state government initiatives. The intended beneficiaries are those creating new ponds for fish or shrimp culture in saline/alkaline areas. The scheme is implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The polythene lining cost shall be provided for new water bodies created under the various state government.
1. Beneficiaries shall be provided with central assistance for the polythene lining cost for the initial crop only in newly constructed.
1. Central assistance for the Polythene lining cost shall be released only after the ponds are ready for fish/shrimp culture.
1. The projects having land on long-term lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. 
The subsidy provided will be limited to 25% of the project cost for all categories.

Scheme Name: Implementation of Scheme for Providing Implements/Machinery on Subsidy to the Farmers of Scheduled Caste Category (SB-89) Short Title: ISPIMSFSC Detailed Description: The "Implementation of Scheme for Providing Implements/Machinery on Subsidy to the Farmers of Scheduled Caste Category (SB-89)" has been launched by the Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to promote agricultural mechanization among Scheduled Caste farmers, increase their income, generate employment opportunities, and make them eligible for other mechanization schemes where tractor ownership is mandatory. Scheme Implementation: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Haryana, through the District Level Executive Committee (DLEC), Deputy Directors of Agriculture, and Assistant Agriculture Engineers. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
Benefits: Subsidy for Purchase of Tractor Financial assistance in the form of subsidy is provided for the purchase of a tractor. The tractor must have a minimum power of 35 Horsepower (HP). The farmer may purchase a tractor of any make from the list of empanelled manufacturers. The subsidy amount is released after purchase, verification, and approval by the competent authority. Conditions Related to Benefits The selected farmer must purchase the tractor within 15 days of selection. The tractor must be physically verified by the committee constituted by the District Level Executive Committee. The beneficiary cannot sell or transfer the tractor for 5 years from the date of purchase. If the tractor is sold before the completion of 5 years, the beneficiary must refund the subsidy amount along with applicable interest.

Scheme Name: Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste Families

Short Title: IHDPSSCF


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste Families”, implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to promote diversification into horticultural crops to improve the income and livelihood of scheduled castes farmers who have small landholdings. Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste farmers will be provided with quality planting material and other inputs for mushroom cultivation, bamboo stacking in vegetables, and protected cultivation with a subsidy of up to 90%. Additionally, training will be offered on various aspects of these practices.
Objectives:
To encourage the SC farmers to take horticultural crops as diversification option.
To acquaint the SC farmers about the latest technologies in the field of horticulture.
To increase the income of the land of SC families by way of increasing output by adopting various horticultural crops.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
   1. The farmer should be a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste community.
   1. The applicant should own or lease agricultural land.

**Note:** The scheme targets Scheduled Caste families with small landholdings in the state.


Benefits:
Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste farmers receive 90% subsidy on components like Mushroom Trays, Bamboo Stacking in vegetable crops, Protected Structures (Poly House/Net House/Walk-in-Tunnels), Cultivation of High Value vegetables/ flowers under Protected Structures and other cultivation technologies in Haryana.
Training will be provided on various aspects of horticultural crops cultivation technologies.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 30-Ton Capacity - Haryana

Short Title: FIPCS


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 30-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 30 tons to strengthen fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR/SCP to keep the unit operational, bear all post-construction costs, and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR/SCP to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs, and to ensure the continuous operation of the ice plant/cold storage.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana

Short Title: CNPSAAHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Ponds for Saline/Alkaline Areas" by the Department of Fisheries, Government of Haryana, aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas. Through this scheme, subsidies for the construction of new ponds and central financial assistance for the initial fish crop on newly constructed ponds are provided to beneficiaries. The scheme considers ponds with a long duration and a registered lease period of at least 7 years for grants.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new ponds subsidy will be provided by the state government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme.
1. Only central financial assistance will be provided to the beneficiaries for the initial fish crop only on the fertiliser of newly constructed ponds.
1. Central financial assistance on the construction of new ponds will be provided only on ponds prepared for fisheries.
1. Under this scheme, ponds whose pond duration will be for a long time, and the registered lease period will be at least 7 years, will be considered for a grant on those ponds.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. 
The subsidy is limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category and 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Kiosks Including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental Fish-Haryana

Short Title: SCFKIKAOFHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of Fish Kiosks including Kiosks of Aquarium/Ornamental fish" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide central assistance for the construction of fish kiosks, including those for aquarium/ornamental fish.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self Contained Proposal (SCP) to the effect that all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by them.
1. The applicant should ensure the fish kiosk will be kept in operational condition for 10 years.
1. The applicant should display a board permanently at the infrastructure facilities to the effect that the fish kiosk is constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY).
1. The applicant can only avail of central assistance for one unit.
1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/ agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹10,00,000/- per unit. Subsidy of 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries. Subsidy of 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia etc - Haryana

Short Title: IFFWA


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Inputs for fresh water Aquaculture, including Composite fish culture, Scampi, Pangasius, Tilapia, etc, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to expand fisheries production in Haryana. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It provides input cost subsidies for the first crop in newly constructed ponds under PMMSY, aiming to promote aquaculture in urban and semi-urban areas.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana with a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant will be eligible for input cost subsidy provided by the State Government only for the expansion of fisheries in urban or semi-urban areas under the construction of new ponds.
1. The applicant will receive central financial assistance only for the initial fish crop (fertilizer) in newly constructed ponds.
1. The applicant will be eligible for central financial assistance on input costs only if the pond is properly prepared for fisheries.
1. The applicant may use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years, for eligibility under this scheme.


Benefits:
The project cost is: 4,00,000/- per hectare
Subsidy Distribution:
40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries
60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries

Short Title: CNGOPHR


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana: Construction of New Grow out Ponds" by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas through the construction of new grow-out ponds. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to beneficiaries who are engaged in fisheries.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The construction of new grow-out ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new grow-out ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme.
1. Central financial assistance for the construction of new grow-out ponds will be provided only for the ponds prepared for fisheries.
1. The applicant should have own land with clear title or having land on a long-term registered lease, not less than a minimum of 7 years.


Benefits:

The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their economic status by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas. Under this scheme, a subsidy is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries to partially cover the lease amount for Panchayati ponds or watershed areas from the second year to the fifth year, thereby reducing long-term operational costs and facilitating the continuation of pond lease arrangements. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: 40% of the actual lease amount OR ₹40,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary. Note: Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General)

Short Title: SPEOEPSGUG


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana. This is a credit-linked scheme with a primary objective of providing self-employment opportunities, the unemployed persons will be assisted by way of establishing Sheep or Goat Units (15 female+1 male) and Piggery Units (10 female+1 male). 
Medium-term objectives:
To provide self-employment to the unemployed.
To provide socio-economic security to weaker sections/Antyodaya Families of the society.
To increase wool/meat/pork production in the State.
Long-term objectives:
Creation of employment opportunities through Animal Husbandry activities.
Increase in wool/meat/pork production of the state.
Upgradation and conservation of valuable breeds/germplasm available in the State.
The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways:
Sponsoring of loan applications to banks/financial institutions.
Purchase of animals, tagging, and issuance of Health certificates.
Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc.
Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division/District Level in the State to the desirous persons.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant must be unemployed (employment even in the private sector would bar an applicant from availing assistance under the Scheme).
   1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
   1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit would not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.
   1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.

**Note:** In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept. Then, the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept or intended to be kept (Within state of Haryana only).


Benefits:
Financial Assistance under the Scheme:
Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units:
25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for the establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit.
A maximum amount of ₹25,000/- could be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:
25 % subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.
A maximum amount of ₹24,500/- could be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Note 1:
 The financial assistance will be provided by the Government in the form of a subsidy after three months of establishment of the unit and tagging or loan disbursement by the bank whichever is later, subject to verification of the unit by the concerned Veterinary Surgeon.
Note 2:
 The financial assistance may be delayed due to non-availability of the budget or any other unforeseen circumstances.
Note 3:
 The subsidy will be provided in the Loan account of the beneficiary.
Financial Assistance for Livestock Insurance under the Scheme:
If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of a unit is to be covered under that Scheme, wherever permissible.
However, if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own.

Scheme Name: Mukhyamantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes Short Title: MBBPUYHR Detailed Description: The "Mukhya Mantri Bhed/Bakri (Sheep/Goat) Palak Uthan Yojana for Scheduled Castes" scheme is introduced by the Animal Husbandry and Dairying Department, Government of Haryana, which aims to uplift Scheduled Caste beneficiaries by providing them with sheep or goat units. Through this scheme, 10 female and 1 male sheep/goat units are provided free of cost. Through this scheme, free sheep or goat units, veterinary assistance, and assistance for purchasing wool are provided to unemployed residents of Haryana. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB). Long-term objectives of this scheme are as follows: To create self-employment opportunities through Sheep and Goat husbandry activities. To upgrade and develop the Sheep and Goat breeds/germ plasm available in the State. To increase income generation opportunities for the economically weaker segment of society. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Caste 1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana 1. The applicant should be a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should not be employed even in the Private Sector/ Govt. /Semi Govt. Organizations. 1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. Any group/firm/organisation would not be permitted to apply under the Scheme, as the Scheme being individual beneficiary-oriented. 1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration in the format annexed as [Annexure-I (Page-9)](https://pashudhanharyana.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/Scheme%202024-25/BhedBakri%20(SheepGoat)%20Palak%20Utthan%20Yojanafor%20the%20year%202024-25%20(N).pdf) on the portal for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.
Benefits: Sheep Unit: 20 Ewes and one Ram with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost. Goat Unit: 20 Does and one Buck with Green Fodder cum Salt Block Feeder free of cost. Veterinary Assistance: All animals in the established unit will receive deworming, vaccination, and treatment free of cost by the concerned Veterinary Institution. Wool Purchase Assistance: Assistance for purchasing wool from the established unit will be provided by the department. Financial Assistance in form of subsidy for establishment of Sheep/Goat unit under the Scheme:- 100% subsidy for the establishment of a Sheep and Goat unit of 10 females and 1 male would be provided to the Scheduled Caste (SC). Initially beneficiary has to bear purchase cost of Sheep and Goat unit by there-own for 25% of the unit cost which will be of ₹17,500/- per unit as margin money (proof for the same should be given by beneficiary), which would be provided to beneficiary account later on as per scheme guidelines. In the case of SC Category, the Haryana Livestock Development Board (HLDB)/Government will provide financial assistance of 75% of the unit cost (₹52,500/- per unit) on the establishment of the livestock unit after the purchase of livestock to the seller within 15 days, upon submission of all requisite documents. The financial assistance of balance 25% of unit cost (₹17,500/- per unit) in case of SC beneficiaries would be provided by the HLDB/Government in form of subsidy to beneficiary after two months of establishment of unit subject to verification of unit after purchase of all cases preferably by Deputy Director concerned himself or its representative not below the rank of Sub Divisional Officer/Semen Bank Officer other than purchase committee. Beneficiaries shall have to purchase a complete/whole Sheep/Goat unit of 10+1 in one slot, and only one beneficiary per household could take the benefit of either Sheep or Goat unit under the scheme. The financial assistance would be provided to the account of the seller through Concerned Semen Bank officer by the Managing Director, HLDB, out of the head of overall receipt of Milk Cess funds after verification and recommendation of the unit established by the Deputy Director concerned or its representative not below the rank of SDO/ SBO. The financial assistance may be delayed due to the unavailability of the budget or any other unforeseen circumstances. The beneficiary would be provided veterinary assistance facilities (Treatment, vaccination and consultancy) by the concerned area veterinary institutions free of cost. Assistance for the purchase of wool from an established unit would be provided by the Department.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana

Short Title: IFSAWA


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It supports input costs for the initial crop in new ponds/tanks, encouraging fish and shrimp culture in Haryana.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must have a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must create new water bodies under the scheme to receive input cost subsidy.
1. The applicant will receive central assistance for input costs only for the initial crop in newly constructed ponds/tanks.
1. The applicant must ensure the ponds/tanks are fully ready for fish or shrimp culture before claiming input cost assistance.
1. The applicant may also use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹6,00,000/- per hectare.
Subsidy Distribution:
40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries
60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries

Scheme Name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Solar System for fish/shrimp culture

Short Title: IFDP-SSSFSC


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Subsidy on Solar System for Fish/Shrimp Culture" is a component of the Intensive Fisheries Development Programme, implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to fish and shrimp farmers for the purchase/installation of solar systems. Under this scheme, subsidies for solar systems are offered to farmers who cultivate fish or shrimp on a minimum area of 2.5 acres. The subsidy benefit is granted only once per beneficiary for a single unit.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years.
1. The applicant should not be a government or semi-government employee.
1. A minimum of 2.5-acre area is required for fish/shrimp culture. 

> **Note:** The benefit/subsidy will be provided only once to a beneficiary on a single unit.


Benefits:
A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost amounting to ₹50,000 per kilowatt (KW) or a subsidy amount of ₹30,000 per KW, whichever is less, is provided.
The maximum limit for this subsidy is 30 KW for shrimp farmers.
The maximum limit for this subsidy is 10 KW for fish farmers.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana

Short Title: IOCIRS


Detailed Description:
The "Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme" was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote sustainable aquaculture practices by supporting cage fish farming in water bodies. Under this scheme, a grant of ₹3,00,000/- per unit to the individuals and groups for setting up cage fish farms, thereby encouraging entrepreneurship, increasing fish production, and generating employment.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be an individual farmer, cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group. 
1. The cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group having a minimum of 10 members. 
1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra).
1. The applicant must obtain prior permission from the Government of Haryana and competent authorities.
1. The cage location must have year-round water availability and a minimum of 8 meters depth.
1. The applicant should take government permission for rearing exotic fish species.


Benefits:
Grant Amount:
₹3,00,000/- per unit (per cage).
Grant Proportion:
40% of unit cost for General Category beneficiaries.
60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries.
Cage Limit for Assistance:
Up to 5 cages for individual farmers.
Up to 20 cages for registered cooperative societies/self-help groups/joint liability groups (with at least 10 members).

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Backyard mini RAS Units - Haryana

Short Title: PMMSY-EBMRASUHR


Detailed Description:
The “Establishment of Backyard Mini RAS Units” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to promote the setup of Mini Recirculatory Aquaculture System (RAS) units to enhance fish production and livelihood opportunities. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to eligible beneficiaries for establishing these units. Various surface and groundwater sources such as canals, rivers, springs, open wells, and tube wells can be utilized for operating RAS units.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
   1. The applicant should provide documentary evidence of the availability of the requisite land free from all encumbrances, financial resources, necessary clearances/permissions.
   1. The water source for RAS units can be any surface or groundwater source, such as a canal, river, spring, open well, tube well, or ground well.
   1. The applicant should ensure that post-construction operation, management, and maintenance of the RAS will be carried out in a satisfactory manner by the beneficiaries at their own cost.
   1. The infrastructure created should have essential requirements for RAS, including water treatment units.
   1. The projects having land on a long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.


Benefits:
Project cost: ₹50,000/- per unit
Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries.
Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
Note: 
General Category:
 Ratio 16% State Share, 24% Central Share and 60% Beneficiary Share.
Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives: 
Ratio 24% State Share, 36% Central Share, 40% Beneficiary Share.

Scheme Name: Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana

Short Title: SPEOEPSGUGMMAPUY


Detailed Description:
The scheme “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities by Establishing Piggery, Sheep and Goat Units (General) under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana” is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana.  Under this scheme, an unemployed resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of livestock, provided they have taken a loan for establishing a 10+1 Piggery unit or a 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant must be unemployed.
   1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
   1. The applicant should have a space/shed for keeping animals.
   1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance under the Scheme:
Establishment of 10+1 Piggery units: 
25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of a 10+1 Piggery unit. A maximum amount of ₹25,000/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat units:
25% subsidy on the cost of livestock which has been availed as a loan by the beneficiary for establishment of 15+1 Sheep/Goat unit. A maximum amount of ₹24,500/- will be provided as financial assistance in form of a subsidy.
Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme:
Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year; otherwise, the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.

Scheme Name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana

Short Title: PDDUSPBY


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" by the Haryana Livestock Development Board, Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of Haryana, aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners, including Scheduled Caste (SC) and Below Poverty Line (BPL) beneficiaries, with subsidised premium rates.


Eligibility Criteria:
- The applicant should be a livestock owner.
- The applicant should be above 18 years of age.
- The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), issued by the state of Haryana.

**Preference and Relaxations**

- Applicants from Scheduled Caste and Below Poverty Line categories will be given priority.
- Scheduled Caste beneficiaries are exempt from paying premiums; the state and central governments fully subsidize their insurance.


Benefits:
Financial Protection
Coverage for livestock loss due to death, providing financial security to farmers.
Sum insured is determined based on the market value of livestock and milk yield.
Maximum coverage is up to five large animals or equivalent small animals per household.
Subsidized Premiums
APL beneficiaries pay ₹100/200/300 per large animal per year based on milk yield or ₹25/- per small animal.
BPL beneficiaries receive additional subsidies, and SC beneficiaries have their entire premium covered by the state and central government.
Mode and Frequency of Disbursement
Claims are settled through direct bank transfers to beneficiaries.
Accidental death claims are covered immediately; non-accidental death claims are covered after a 21-day waiting period.
Expected Time of Disbursement
Insurance companies are required to settle claims within 15 days of document submission. Delays incur a penalty of 12% compound interest per annum.

Scheme Name: Special Livestock Insurance Scheme

Short Title: SLISC


Detailed Description:
"Special Livestock Insurance Scheme" by the Animal Husbandry & Dairying Department, Government of Haryana is a continuation of a welfare initiative targeting scheduled caste families engaged in livestock rearing. The scheme is designed to provide free insurance for livestock, enhancing the economic security of resource-poor Scheduled Caste families. It has been allocated a budget of ₹3,00,00,000/- by the State Government and aims to cover various livestock species, including milch animals, sheep, goats, pigs, pack animals, and camels.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste family.
1. The livestock of the applicant should include milch buffaloes, milch cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, pack animals, or camels.
1. The animals must be owned by the applicant.
1. The animals should be reared within the State.

_*Livestock units established under the “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes” are automatically eligible._


Benefits:
Free Insurance Coverage:
 For livestock owned by Scheduled Caste families, ensuring financial protection in case of animal loss.
Employment Support:
 Covers livestock units established under the “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes (SCSP).”
Wide Coverage:
 Includes dairy, piggery, sheep, goat units, milch buffalo, cattle, pack animals, and camels.
Publicity and Awareness:
 ₹5,50,000/- allocated for widespread publicity to ensure maximum participation.
Veterinary Support:
 Honorarium to Veterinary Surgeons for health and post-mortem certificates.
Cost-Free to Beneficiaries:
 Entire costs related to insurance premiums, publicity, and veterinary support are borne by the State Government.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of Minimum 20-Ton Capacity - Haryana

Short Title: FIPCSOMTC


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 20-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy for 20-ton capacity ice plant/cold storage units, supports the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 20 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Beneficiaries must submit an undertaking in their DPR agreeing to keep the unit operational, cover all post-construction costs, and supply ice to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs, and to ensure the continuous functioning of the ice plant/cold storage.
1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided as per the actual cost, subject to the ceiling limits under relevant PMMSY sub-components.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price.
1. The applicant must either own the project land or hold it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years to be eligible.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹80,00,000/-
Subsidy Distribution :
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity Haryana

Short Title: FIPCSOMC


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Store of minimum 10-ton capacity, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide the subsidy to support the establishment of ice plants or cold storage facilities with a minimum capacity of 10 tons to improve fish preservation and cold chain infrastructure in Haryana.
This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. Eligible beneficiaries must undertake to keep the unit operational, cover maintenance and post-construction costs, and ensure ice is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the DPR agreeing to bear all operational, maintenance, and post-construction costs.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice plant/cold storage remains continuously operational.
1. The applicant must ensure that the ice produced is supplied to fishers and fish farmers at affordable prices.
1. The applicant must either own the land or have it on a long-term registered lease of at least 10 years.
1. The applicant must note that central assistance will be provided based on actual costs, within the overall ceiling limits specified under PMMSY sub-components.
1. The applicant must understand that, upon approval, the subsidy will be disbursed as per the procedure laid out under PMMSY.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹40,00,000/-
Subsidy Distribution :
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana

Short Title: PMMSYMCIBHR


Detailed Description:
The “Motor Cycle with Ice Box” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra.
1. The applicant should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition.
1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only motorcycle with ice box.
1. The applicant should utilize the vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities.
1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance provided under the scheme:
Project Cost: ₹75,000/- per unit
Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries.
Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
