Scheme Name: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana

Short Title: FIPCSOM


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity , introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide financial assistance for setting up ice plants or cold storage units with a minimum capacity of 50 tons, supporting cold chain infrastructure under PMMSY. The aim is to reduce post-harvest losses and improve fish quality. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, funded in the ratio of: 50% by the Central Government, and 50% by the State Government. The beneficiary must operate and maintain the plant and ensure supply of ice to fishers at affordable prices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicant must submit an undertaking within the DPR/SCP, accepting full responsibility for operating and maintaining the unit.
1. The applicant must provide ice at affordable prices to fishers.
1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) in accordance with PMMSY guidelines.
1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in ice plant or cold storage operation and maintenance.
1. The applicant must ensure the land is free from legal issues and must provide a valid land title.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹150,00,000/-
   
Subsidy Distribution:
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana Short Title: LFFMPC20TD Detailed Description: The "Large Fish Feed Mill with Production Capacity of 20 Ton/Per Day" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), it aims to strengthen post-harvest infrastructure and enhance fish feed production to support sustainable aquaculture. Under this scheme, a grant is provided to beneficiaries for setting up a large fish feed mill, with 40% subsidy for general category and 60% for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The Beneficiaries will submit an undertaking in the DPR to the effect that all operational, maintenance and post construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them and the Fish Feed Plant will be kept in operational condition. 1. Central assistance for Fish Feed Mill will be as per actual cost within the overall ceiling indicated in the respective sub-components/activities under PMMSY. 1. The Beneficiary will ensure supply of feed produced from the government assisted Fish Feed Plant to the fishers and fish farmers at affordable price. 1. The projects having land on long term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.
Benefits: Monetary Assistance: Grant of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for establishing a fish feed mill with 20-ton/day capacity. Subsidy Provisions: 40% subsidy on unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. 60% subsidy on unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana Short Title: IVS Detailed Description: The "Insulated Vehicle" scheme was launched by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, under the umbrella scheme "Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana". It aims to promote efficient and hygienic fish transportation systems. Under this scheme, a financial grant is provided to the beneficiaries for purchasing insulated (reefer) vehicles used in fish transportation. It seeks to minimize post-harvest losses, improve fish value chains, and enhance earnings of fish farmers by enabling cold-chain logistics. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: Financial grant of up to ₹20,00,000/- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. Grant Limits: 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. Note Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. The applicant should agree that any losses in procurement, operation, or maintenance are their own responsibility, and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day Short Title: PMMSYMFFMPC2TD Detailed Description: The “Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to strengthen inland aquaculture infrastructure by promoting the establishment of small-scale fish feed mills. Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant/beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. All operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by the beneficiary. 1. The beneficiary should ensure that the Fish Feed Mill remains in functional condition. 1. The beneficiary should supply the feed produced from the government-assisted Fish Feed Mill/Plant to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant should either own the land or have it on a registered lease agreement valid for a minimum of 10 years.
Benefits: Tangible Benefits: Project Cost: ₹30,00,000/- per unit Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
Benefits: 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.

Scheme Name: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money Short Title: SWSCFFSS1YLM Detailed Description: The “Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money” is a scheme component under the Scheme for the Welfare of Scheduled Caste Families in the Fisheries Sector, launched by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and to uplift these families by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas. Under this scheme, a subsidy is provided to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries to partially cover the lease cost, thereby reducing the financial burden during the initial stages of aquaculture. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. The pond lease period should not be less than 5 years. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
Benefits: Financial Assistance: 50% of the actual lease amount OR ₹50,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary.

Scheme Name: Solar Water Pumping System Short Title: SSWPS Detailed Description: The scheme "Solar Water Pumping System" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana, aims to encourage farmers and agriculture-based community groups to adopt clean and sustainable energy for irrigation by offering subsidized solar water pumping systems. It helps in improving agricultural productivity, reducing dependency on grid electricity or diesel, and promoting water-use efficiency through integration with micro-irrigation systems. Beneficiaries are eligible for a 75% subsidy on the installation of solar pumps. Eligibility Criteria: 1. Any Haryana Resident family with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP). 1. Farmers of Haryana with no electric agricultural connection in his/her name. 1. Water User Associations, Gaushalas, and community/cluster-based irrigation systems. 1. The beneficiaries who have not been covered under the solar pump scheme in past.
Benefits: Subsidy Amount: A 75% subsidy is provided on the cost of solar water pumps.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana

Short Title: EOLHR


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Large RAS / Biofloc Culture System, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming. It is a centrally funded scheme with a 50:50 cost-sharing pattern between the Central and State Governments.
For RAS:
 A minimum of 8 tanks of 90 m³ each (capacity: 40 tons/crop).
For Biofloc:
 50 tanks of 4 m diameter and 1.5 m height.
The scheme encourages the adoption of modern aquaculture infrastructure, particularly by trained and certified individuals. It offers enhanced subsidy support for SC and Women beneficiaries, aiming to boost inclusive and sustainable fish farming practices.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must belong to either the General, Scheduled Caste (SC), or Women category.
1. The applicant must be the owner or legal leaseholder (with a minimum 10-year lease) of the land intended for setting up the unit.
1. The applicant must have access to either surface water or groundwater for aquaculture purposes.
1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture.
1. The applicant must be willing to maintain and operate the unit at personal cost after the initial setup.
1. The applicant must submit a complete Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) for evaluation.
1. The applicant must agree to sign an official agreement with the Fisheries Department to avail of benefits under the scheme.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹50,00,000/-
RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) Subsidy:
A 20% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 25% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.
Biofloc Subsidy:
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana

Short Title: EOS


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of small RAS / Biofloc Culture System, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide  financial assistance for establishing small-scale aquaculture units, either through 1 RAS tank (100 m³ capacity) or 7 Biofloc tanks (4 m diameter × 1.5 m height). It aims to promote sustainable and scientific fish farming for individual farmers with smaller land or capital access. It is a centrally funded scheme with a 50:50 cost-sharing pattern between the Central and State Governments.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must own land or have a registered lease of at least 10 years, free from legal encumbrances.
1. The applicant must have access to a water source such as a canal, well, tube well, or similar.
1. The applicant must be trained in aquaculture or fisheries and hold a valid certification.
1. The applicant must be willing to maintain and operate the system at their own cost post-installation.
1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP).
1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Fisheries Department to be eligible under the scheme.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹7,50,000/-
Subsidy Distribution:
A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category.
A 60% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries.

Scheme Name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Purchase of Fishing Nets (Scheduled Caste)

Short Title: IFDPSPFN


Detailed Description:
The "Subsidy on Purchase of Fishing Nets" is a scheme component under the Intensive Fisheries Development Programme, introduced by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals from Scheduled Caste families engaged in fishing activities for the purchase of fishing nets. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can avail a subsidy of up to 60% on the cost of fishing nets.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old.
1. The applicant should present a GST-paid bill for the purchase of fishing nets.
1. The applicant can apply only once in two years for this subsidy.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance is provided to Fish Farmers under the scheme: 
Financial assistance of 60% subsidy on the purchase of fishing nets of amounting to ₹40,000/-.
The maximum subsidy amount is ₹24,000/-.
Note: 
Subsidy is available only once in two years per beneficiary.

Scheme Name: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles

Short Title: IFDPSCFWV


Detailed Description:
The "Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles" is a scheme component under the Intensive Fisheries Development Programme, implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. The scheme aims to strengthen the fisheries value chain by providing transportation support to fish farmers. Under this scheme, eligible fish farmers receive a subsidy of 25% of the actual cost on the purchase of a commercial four-wheeler vehicle used for fisheries-related activities.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.


Benefits:
Subsidy under the scheme is provided at the rate of 25% of the actual cost of the four-wheeler (₹9 lakh) or ₹2.25 lakh, whichever is lower.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana

Short Title: PMMSYRVHR


Detailed Description:
The “Refrigerated Vehicles” is a scheme component under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. This is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure and ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness and quality of fish during post-harvest handling and transportation.


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra.
   1. The applicant should ensure that the refrigerated vehicle remains operational for fish transportation.
   1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only one refrigerated vehicle.
   1. The applicant should utilize the refrigerated vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities.
   1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.


Benefits:
Financial Assistance provided under the scheme:
Project Cost: ₹25,00,000/- per unit
Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries.
Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.

raw_text:
Scheme Name: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana

Short Title: EOM


Detailed Description:
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc Culture System,  introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems. These models promote high-density fish production in controlled environments, significantly reducing land and water usage. It is a centrally funded scheme with a 50:50 cost-sharing pattern between the Central and State Governments.
For RAS:
 Minimum 6 tanks of 30 m³ each (10 tons/crop)
For Biofloc:
 25 tanks of 4 m diameter and 1 m height


Eligibility Criteria:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must have access to own land or hold a registered lease for a minimum period of 10 years.
1. The applicant must ensure that the land is free from any legal and financial encumbrances.
1. The applicant must have access to a reliable water source such as a canal, tube well, river, or similar.
1. The applicant must provide a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture.
1. The applicant must agree to manage and maintain the system at their own cost after setup.
1. The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP).
1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Department of Fisheries to avail benefits under the scheme.


Benefits:
The project cost is ₹25,00,000/-
 
Subsidy Distribution:
40% subsidy for General Category beneficiaries.
60% subsidy for SC and Women category beneficiaries.

raw_text:
Scheme Name: Mahila Kisan Yojana

Short Title: MKYH


Detailed Description:
The scheme "Mahila Kisan Yojana" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Government of Haryana. Through this scheme, loans are provided to the eligible women from Scheduled Castes for the betterment of their economic status through self-employment activities in the Agriculture and Allied Sector. The Corporation in collaboration with NSFDC provide loan for various economic development schemes having unit cost upto ₹ 50,000/-. The Corporation provides margin money @ 10% of the project cost.


Eligibility Criteria:
- The applicant should be a female.
  - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
  - The applicant should be from a &#39;Scheduled Caste&#39;.
  - The applicant&#39;s annual family income should not exceed the Below Poverty Line (BPL).
  - The applicant&#39;s name should be present in the BPL survey list.
  - The income ceiling is at least 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹1,50,000/- and balance 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹3,00,000/-.


Benefits:
Loan for various economic development schemes having unit cost up to ₹50,000/-.
Margin Money at 10% of the project cost.
Subsidy at 50% of the total project cost (max. ₹10,000/-).
